{{Infobox Location |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= File:BotW Flight Range.png |Screenshot TotK= File:TotK Flight Range.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |inhab= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= [[Teba]], [[Tulin]] |TotK= [[Kaneli]] }} |items= |related= {{List| * [[Dronoc's Pass]] * [[Noe Rajee Shrine]] * [[Rito Village]] }} |season= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Flight Range||Series, BotW, TotK, AoC}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC}}{{Cite|{{Big|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|'''Flight Range'''}}}}|Map|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color TotK|Map Blue|Flight Range}}|Map|TotK}}{{Cite|Some Rito workers are performing maintenance on the Flight Range. They want the platform strong enough to withstand bomb-arrow blasts. Get some sturdy materials for them to use.|Gallery (Interface)|AoC}} also known as the '''Rito Flight Range''',{{Exp Game|BotW}}{{Cite|Rito Flight Range {{Icon|BotW Arrow Right}}|Sign|BotW}} is a recurring location in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Features and Overview== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Descriptions BotW}} The Flight Range is a [[Rito]] training ground located at the end of [[Dronoc's Pass]] in the [[Hebra Mountains]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 313}} Rito warriors use the Flight Range to prepare for aerial battles due to its consistent [[Updraft]]s.{{Cite|[Where did he go?] Well... My husband headed to a place called the {{Color BotW|Red|Flight Range}}. It's in {{Color BotW|Blue|Dronoc's Pass}} at the base of the {{Color BotW|Blue|Hebra Mountains}}. It's a place where Rito warriors prepare for aerial combat... I imagine he's gone there to gather weapons for another run at {{Color BotW|Blue|Medoh}}. As it happens, he made his way to the {{Color BotW|Red|Flight Range}} on foot this time.|Saki|BotW}}{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 400}} As such, the Range features a number of [[Target]]s, as well as a [[House]] containing a [[Cooking Pot]] and a good amount of [[Rito Gear]]. The bottom of the Range is covered in a pool of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Since it exists within a [[Freezing Climate]], [[Link]] requires at least two levels of [[Cold Resistance]] to visit the Flight Range without taking damage. 100 years ago, the Flight Range was built at [[Revali]]'s request as a reward for winning an archery tournament, since he required training grounds to improve his skills at.{{Cite|I won another archery competition today. As one would expect, the village can't stop talking about my winning streak. In short order, I've managed to break all of the previous records and set an insurmountably high bar. Everywhere I go I receive praise and affirmations that I am the pride of the Rito. I...could get used to this. The elder asked me what I would like as a prize for my achievements. I told him I wish for an archery training ground. If I am to keep this up, I need somewhere to train at various elevations. I'm hoping to master a new move I've dreamed up...|The Diary of Revali|BotW}} When the Rito children expressed interest in training there too, Revali decided to open the Flight Range to the public, hoping it would nurture the next generation of warriors.{{Cite|The Rito children look up to me. I hear they wish to start training at the Flight Range too. Perhaps it's not a bad idea to allow everyone to use my training space. These are dangerous times, after all.|The Diary of Revali|BotW}} [[File:BotW Champion Revali's Song Thumbnail.png|thumb|left|250px|Princess Zelda and Revali at the Flight Range]] Prior to the second [[Great Calamity]], [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] visited the Flight Range in search of Revali, seeking to appoint him as a [[Champions|Champion]] and pilot of [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]].{{Cite|Zelda tracks down Rito warrior Revali and enlists him to pilot the Divine Beast Vah Medoh. During their encounter, she witnesses an impressive display of skills as well as the hidden side of his personality that makes it all possible.|Adventure Log|BotW}} There, she witnesses Revali practicing his [[Revali's Gale|Gale]], but he gets caught up in the whirlwind and is thrown back to the ground. After noticing Zelda, Revali officially accepts her offer.{{Cite|You have need of me. To defeat Calamity Ganon. To slay the beast once and for all... It will be my great pleasure.|Revali|BotW}} He then attempts his Gale once more, this time successfully launching himself off of the ground and destroying all of the Flight Range's Targets with [[Bomb Arrow]]s. Landing by the House, Revali asserts that he will play the biggest role in helping seal [[Calamity Ganon]], and he says not to come crying to him if Link loses his confidence after seeing his skills.{{Cite|I know I play the biggest part in helping that, ahem... that little knight with the darkness-sealing sword. Correct? Well, if he loses his confidence after seeing me in action... don't come crying to me.|Revali|BotW}} These events can be seen as part of the "[[Champion Revali's Song (Memory)|Champion Revali's Song]]" [[EX Recovered Memory]] that appears during the "[[EX Champion Revali's Song]]" [[Main Quest]], which is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack. After failing to defeat Divine Beast Vah Medoh when it reactivated, the Rito warrior [[Teba]] fell back to the Flight Range to prepare for another attack. When Link arrives at the Flight Range during the "[[Divine Beast Vah Medoh (Quest)|Divine Beast Vah Medoh]]" Main Quest, he will find Teba working on a [[Falcon Bow]]. Though Teba is initially distrusting of Link,{{Cite|[Vah Medoh...] {{Big|Let me get this straight...}} Some random Hylian wants to help me bring down Divine Beast Vah Medoh? I'm not buying it.|Teba|BotW}} he eventually accepts his help.{{Cite|[Then let's get started.] Are you serious? HA! Well, far be it from me to talk you off the ledge.|Teba|BotW}} However, he first needs to test Link by having him destroy five of the Flight Range's Targets within three minutes.{{Cite|...So I'm going to need to test you before I take you with me. We Rito warriors use the {{Color BotW|Red|updraft}} in this ravine to hone our aerial {{Color BotW|Red|archery}} skills. The {{Color BotW|Red|updrafts}} are so strong here that a person could just open up a cloth over their head and float up easily. Now let's see what you're capable of. You'll have to maneuver through the air and destroy {{Color BotW|Red|five of the targets}} set up in this valley {{Color BotW|Red|in three minutes}}.|Teba|BotW}} When Link completes the [[Flight Range (Mini-Game)|Flight Range]], Teba commends his skills.{{Cite|You're...a skilled archer. It was as if time stopped with every arrow you let fly. I've got to tell you, Link... When you first showed up, I thought someone was pulling a prank on me. But after seeing you handle that bow, I can tell you're the real deal. You must have seen a battle or two.|Teba|BotW}} To help Link against the [[Divine Beast]], Teba directs him to a stone [[Treasure Chest]] on the landing, which contains a Falcon Bow that he was modifying.{{Cite|Well, if you really want to help me bring down {{Color BotW|Blue|Medoh}}, it's now or never. I'll get you into position so you can give its {{Color BotW|Red|cannons}} all you've got. Inside that treasure chest is a {{Color BotW|Blue|bow}} I've modified. Take it, and let me know when you're ready.|Teba|BotW}} Teba also gifts Link a bundle of 20 [[Bomb Arrow]]s to use on the [[Cannon (Enemy)|Cannons]].{{Cite|OK, it's time to face {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast Vah Medoh}}. Normal arrows won't put a dent in those {{Color BotW|Red|cannons}}. You'll need to hit them with {{Color BotW|Blue|bomb arrows}}. These are a precious commodity, so don't expect me to do this again, but...take these {{Color BotW|Blue|bomb arrows}}.|Teba|BotW}} Following the fight against Divine Beast Vah Medoh, Teba will retreat to the Flight Range to deal with his injured leg.{{Cite|Bad news, Link. It looks like I got hit pretty good back there... I think I need to get back to the Flight Range. I just hope that... I can make it back...|Teba|BotW}} If Link visits the Flight Range before appeasing Vah Medoh, Teba will express his frustration that he got hurt after he was so close to defeating the Divine Beast.{{Cite|You... I can't believe it got me... My leg is in worse shape than I thought. And I was so close to stopping {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast Vah Medoh}}... Dammit!|Teba|BotW}} Once Link receives the [[Great Eagle Bow]], Teba will take his son, [[Tulin]], to practice at the Flight Range.{{Cite|Well then... My wounds are just about healed, so I guess it's time for me to take Tulin to the {{Color BotW|Blue|Flight Range}}. I'm hoping Tulin grows up to be a distinguished warrior like Master Revali.|Teba|BotW}} While there, he will ask Link to demonstrate his archery skills for Tulin.{{Cite|Would you mind showing Tulin how you handle a bow? Watching a master at work and trying to copy their technique is a good start when it comes to training, after all.|Teba|BotW}} Tulin also asks Link to show him his skills as part of the Flight Range Mini-Game, challenging Link to destroy as many Targets as he can in a limited amount of time.{{Cite|[I'm all right.] Nuh-uh! Dad said you were great, and Dad never lies, so it must be true! Come on, show me!|Tulin|BotW}}{{Cite|I'll count down, and you'll break all the {{Color BotW|Red|targets}} before time's up! When you break a bunch, I'll give you a prize!|Tulin|BotW}} During the "EX Champion Revali's Song" Main Quest, the Targets at the Flight Range start to glow with the [[Crest of the Sheikah]]. As part of the [[Divine Beast Tamer's Trial]], Link must shoots four of these Targets.{{Cite|♪Wind's ally soars the land of cloud.
{{Color BotW|Blue|Medoh}}'s Champion, swift and proud.♪
♪The hero's power shall grow.
Seek trials {{Color BotW|Blue|monuments}} show.♪
♪One, {{Color BotW|Red|shoot the flame dragon's horn}}.
Two, {{Color BotW|Red|race down a peak rings adorn}}.♪
♪Three, {{Color BotW|Red|shoot four targets to win}}.
Champion, the trials begin!♪|Kass|BotW}} Doing so causes [[Noe Rajee Shrine]] to emerge from the ground at the bottom of the Flight Range. A total of two Treasure Chests are hidden at the Flight Range. Both are made of metal and are submerged in the Water at the bottom of the Range, though Link can use [[Magnesis]] to pull them to the surface. These Chests contain a [[Knight's Broadsword]] and a [[Gold Rupee]]. [[File:BotW Korok Seed Icon.png|left|40px]] One [[Korok Seed Puzzle]] can be found at the Flight Range. It takes the form of a group of [[Leaves with Fairy Dust]] on the roof of the Range's House. When Link examines the Leaves, a [[Korok]] will appear and give him a [[Korok Seed]] as a reward.{{Cite|Yahaha! You found me!|Korok|BotW}} ====Equipment==== {{Gallery List|Objects |BotW= Swallow Bow }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== After retiring as chieftain of [[Rito Village]], [[Kaneli]] operates the Flight Range as a training center for young [[Rito]] warriors. ====Equipment==== {{Gallery List|Equipment |TotK= Arrow x 5, Swallow Bow }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Flight Range House.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The Flight Range House File:BotW Flight Range House Interior.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The Flight Range House interior File:BotW Flight Range Korok.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The Korok found at the Flight Range File:TotK Flight Range House.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}The Flight Range House File:TotK Flight Range House Interior.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}The interior of the Flight Range House File:TotK Flight Range 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}The Flight Range prior to completing "Tulin of Rito Village" File:TotK Flight Range House 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}The Flight Range House prior to completing "Tulin of Rito Village" File:TotK Flight Range House Interior 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}The interior of the Flight Range House prior to completing "Tulin of Rito Village" ==See Also== {{See Also| * Dronoc's Pass * Hebra Mountains * Noe Rajee Shrine * Rito Village }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Hebra Mountains, Tracks |locations= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
